title: Activate (Server)
description: scripting-4c AC1/AC3 — a forwarded activate, sent to the current ready script host ONLY. `from` is the sender's session id, for the host's log line: it is never identity or authority. `hostGen` is the generation the forward belongs to.

from.description: scripting-4c Rev 2 W2 — the same bound as `hello.client.json`'s `id` (1–64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]). `from` is the forwarded `hello` id, for the log line only (pin 1); the server checks it before it forwards (defence in depth — W1 is what keeps it unreachable).
